description: This file defines Express route handlers for managing job postings in a job board application. It includes routes to list all jobs, retrieve details of a single job, create, update, and delete jobs, with authentication and authorization checks.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all jobs, with populated company name, sorted by creation date.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific job by ID, with populated company name and applications.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new job, restricted to users with 'employer' role, and links job to company.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update a job, restricted to the poster (owner) of the job.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a job, restricted to the poster (owner) of the job.
